violations.why: irq_summit can preempt the task between the two reads of v_fjord and change it, so the reads can return different values.
irq_summit can preempt the task between the two reads of v_nimbus and change it, so the reads can return different values.
If irq_summit runs earlier, its enable_isr(2) unmasks irq_vessel globally. irq_vessel can then preempt the task between the two reads of v_anchor and write it.
